value.rationale: Weak-Allee prey grows away from zero on the predator-free axis, yet the exact model admits open strictly-positive extinction sectors and, in one rational witness, simultaneously admits locally stable positive coexistence. The result identifies a physically interpretable transition at prey-growth alpha=predator mortality gamma/e from comparable 1/t decay to a universal 1/(t log t) critical law to a parameter-dependent faster power, beyond a routine steady-state or Turing eigenvalue calculation.
